text:
maria: Heads up — seeing ~1% of /v1/embeddings preflight calls return 413 when clients set `Content-Encoding: gzip`. Router logs show size check is against compressed bytes, so small savings from gzip still trigger a 413.

oliver: Yep saw that in SRE queue. Router enforces `max_payload_bytes` on the wire. We never decompressed for preflight.

sanjay: Decompressing at the router would be expensive. We need a cheaper negotiation. Can we require an opt-in header from SDKs like `x-uncompressed-bytes`?

maria: Clients won't always set that. Many mobile SDKs gzip automatically. Failing silently is rough. Maybe a user-friendly error first?

kevin: Short term: return 413 with an explanatory body + suggestion to send `x-uncompressed-bytes` or set `Content-Encoding: identity`. That will unblock integrators.

tara: For Console: we should surface gzip-caused rejects in the quota dashboard (new metric `embed/gzip_rejects`) and show estimated uncompressed size when possible. UX: give a button to toggle "prefer server-size-preflight" for orgs.

oliver: Long term options:
- trust `x-uncompressed-bytes` from SDKs for quota checks (fast)
- accept gzip and sample-decompress on a small % for telemetry/abuse detection (cheap)
- or do full decompression in a dedicated preflight worker pool (costly)

maria: I like the hybrid: SDK header + sample decompress. We can instrument and after N days, consider auto-decompress for all if overhead is OK.

infra-bot: [router.log snippet]
```
time=1719998888 level=warn component=router route=/v1/embeddings client=acme size=621387 compressed=true result=preflight_reject reason=payload_too_large limit=512000
```

kevin: +1 on sample decompression. Also need to be careful for Dedicated customers — they might expect identical semantics. We should make this a per-deployment policy.

tara: Rollout plan suggestion: feature flag `embeddings.preflight.gzip_handling` with values `reject_hint` (default), `trust_header`, `sample_decompress`, `full_decompress`. Expose toggle in Console under Routes -> Embeddings.

oliver: Telemetry events: `embed.preflight.failure.reason=gzip_compressed` and `embed.preflight.uncompressed_bytes_estimate`. Also capture `client_sdk_sent_header=true/false`.

maria: Action items:
- oliver: prototype server-side sample decompressor + telemetry (2w)
- kevin: coordinate SDK owners to add `x-uncompressed-bytes` (1w)
- tara: console metric/flag UI mockups (1w)
- sanjay: cost estimate for dedicated preflight decompression (2w)

kevin: @maria can you draft the 413 error text we should surface to customers? I'll wire SDK owners once we have wording.

maria: Draft: `request rejected: compressed payload appears to exceed allowed uncompressed size. Please include the header x-uncompressed-bytes with the uncompressed payload size, or set Content-Encoding: identity. For details see https://redwood.ai/docs/embeddings/payload-limits` :point_left:

tara: I'll add a dashboard card to track rejects and header adoption.

maria: Nice. If nobody objects, we'll start with the header+hint rollout and the feature flag for sample_decompress on staging. :thumbsup:

oliver: No objections from me.

sanjay: Fine by me. Watch CPU on the sample workers.

kevin: I'll follow up with SDK PRs.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag `embeddings.preflight.gzip_handling` created (staging=false)
